choose.when: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(id) id,tax_account taxAccount,basic_account basicAccount,is_default isDefault,bank_name bankName,account_number accountNumber,account_alias accountAlias,currency currency,cnaps cnaps,swift_code swiftCode,remarks remarks,BIN_TO_UUID(created_by) creator,created_at,BIN_TO_UUID(updated_by) updater,updated_at FROM md_partner_bank_account WHERE tenant_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{tenant}) AND partner_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{parent}) AND deleted=FALSE ORDER BY created_at,id
choose.otherwise: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(id) id,contact_type contactType,contact_name contactName,phone phone,address address,is_default isDefault,email email,remarks remarks,BIN_TO_UUID(created_by) creator,created_at,BIN_TO_UUID(updated_by) updater,updated_at FROM md_partner_contact WHERE tenant_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{tenant}) AND partner_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{parent}) AND deleted=FALSE ORDER BY created_at,id

choose.when: UPDATE md_partner_bank_account SET tax_account=#{values.taxAccount},basic_account=#{values.basicAccount},is_default=#{values.isDefault},bank_name=#{values.bankName},account_number=#{values.accountNumber},account_alias=#{values.accountAlias},currency=#{values.currency},cnaps=#{values.cnaps},swift_code=#{values.swiftCode},remarks=#{values.remarks},updated_by=UUID_TO_BIN(#{actor}),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{tenant}) AND partner_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{parent}) AND id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id})
choose.otherwise: UPDATE md_partner_contact SET contact_type=#{values.contactType},contact_name=#{values.contactName},phone=#{values.phone},address=#{values.address},is_default=#{values.isDefault},email=#{values.email},remarks=#{values.remarks},updated_by=UUID_TO_BIN(#{actor}),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{tenant}) AND partner_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{parent}) AND id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id})

choose.when: UPDATE md_partner_bank_account SET deleted=TRUE,updated_by=UUID_TO_BIN(#{actor}),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{tenant}) AND partner_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{parent}) AND id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id})
choose.otherwise: UPDATE md_partner_contact SET deleted=TRUE,updated_by=UUID_TO_BIN(#{actor}),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{tenant}) AND partner_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{parent}) AND id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id})
